title: confiture test-db clone --format json
description: A fresh database cloned from a template with CREATE DATABASE ... WITH TEMPLATE (CloneResult.to_dict). target_url is the server URL with the clone's name as its database and its password redacted. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

target_url.description: A connection URL for the clone: the server URL with its database replaced by target. A password in it is written as ***, never in clear.

tablespace.description: The tablespace the clone landed in, or null for an on-disk clone (including a RAM clone that fell back to disk). The command asks for no tablespace, so it writes null; a library caller that passes one reads its name here.

strategy.description: The CREATE DATABASE … STRATEGY the clone used (PostgreSQL 15+), from CONFITURE_TEST_CLONE_STRATEGY; null when none was asked for and the server's default applied.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
